en.home.description: is a Rust-Based Web Building Engine to Facilitate Your Web Program and JavaScript Library
en.features.fast.title: Extremely Fast
en.features.fast.description: Written in Rust, start a React / Vue project in milliseconds and perform an HMR update within 10ms for most situations.
en.features.incremental.title: Incremental Building
en.features.incremental.description: Incremental Building: Support persistent cache, module level cache enabled by default, any module won't be compiled twice until it's changed!
en.features.bundling.title: Partial Bundling
en.features.bundling.description: Partial Bundling: Bundle your project into a few reasonable bundles, speeding up resource loading without losing caching granularity.
en.features.pluggable.title: Rich Features and Fully Pluggable
en.features.pluggable.description: Farm supports compiling HTML, CSS, CSS Modules, Js/Jsx/Ts/Tsx, JSON, Static Assets out of the box, supports Sass, Less, PostCSS, Vue, React, Solid by way of official plugins, supports lazy compiling, partial bundling and more. Everything inside Farm is powered by plugins, Supports both Rust and JavaScript plugins. Support Vite plugins out of box.
en.features.compatibility.title: Consistency and Compatibility
en.features.compatibility.description: What you see in development will be the same as what you get in production. Supports both legacy (ES5) and modern browsers.
en.editorial.eyebrow: Built in Rust. Made for your flow.
en.editorial.title: Build with focus.
en.editorial.intro: A modern build tool that brings a Rust-powered core, a flexible plugin system, and a thoughtful developer experience to your next project.
en.editorial.configCaption: A small configuration. Room for your ideas.
en.editorial.features: Everything you need. Room to grow.
en.editorial.featuresIntro: One toolchain, from first idea to production.
en.editorial.coreDescription: A native compilation core for modern JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
en.editorial.workflowDescription: Hot updates and familiar configuration keep your attention on what you are building.
en.editorial.pluginsDescription: Compose JavaScript and Rust plugins to shape a build pipeline that fits your product.
en.editorial.communityDescription: Bring your ideas, share a plugin, or help improve Farm.
en.editorial.footer: Built for the way you build.

zh.home.description: 是一个基于 Rust 实现的极速构建引擎，帮助您更快地构建 Web 程序 和 JavaScript 库。
zh.features.fast.title: 超级快
zh.features.fast.description: 用Rust编写，可以在毫秒内启动React/Vue项目，并在大多数情况下在10毫秒内进行热模块替换（HMR）更新。
zh.features.incremental.title: 增量构建
zh.features.incremental.description: 增量构建：默认启用, 支持持久缓存，模块级别缓存，任何模块在未发生变化之前不会被重新编译！
zh.features.bundling.title: 局部打包
zh.features.bundling.description: 自动根据依赖关系、资源大小，将项目打包成若干个资源，提升资源加载性能的同时，保证缓存命中率。
zh.features.pluggable.title: 丰富的特性和完全可插拔
zh.features.pluggable.description: 丰富的编译能力支持: 开箱即用, Farm 内置了 Js/Ts/Jsx/Tsx、Css/Css Modules/Sass/Less、HTML 和静态资源，可以通过官方插件支持 sass、less、postcss、react、vue、solid 等常用技术栈，支持懒编译、局部打包等海量特性。并且 Farm 由插件驱动, 通过创建插件来实现任何您想要的功能, 同时支持 Rust 和 JavaScript 两种插件模式, 开箱即用支持 Vite 插件。
zh.features.compatibility.title: 一致性 & 兼容性
zh.features.compatibility.description: 一致性: 开发环境和生产环境的表现一致，所见即所得。支持传统（ES5）和现代浏览器。
zh.editorial.eyebrow: Rust 驱动，为你的开发节奏而生。
zh.editorial.title: 专注创造。
zh.editorial.intro: 以 Rust 为核心，结合灵活的插件体系和贴心的开发体验，为你的下一个现代 Web 项目提供构建支持。
zh.editorial.configCaption: 简洁的配置，为你的想法留下空间。
zh.editorial.featuresIntro: 从第一个想法，到生产构建。
zh.editorial.coreDescription: 原生编译核心，为现代 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 项目而打造。
zh.editorial.workflowDescription: 热更新与熟悉的配置方式，让你专注于正在创造的产品。
zh.editorial.pluginsDescription: 组合 JavaScript 与 Rust 插件，构建适合自己产品的工作流。
zh.editorial.communityDescription: 分享想法、编写插件，或帮助 Farm 变得更好。
zh.editorial.footer: 为你的开发方式而构建。
